vendor.name: Kuaishou / Kling AI (Kwai)
vendor.notes: Kling AI was carved out into a separate legal entity in 2026 (Beijing Kling Intelligent Technology; ~US$3B round announced 2026-07-02 at ~US$18B post-money; Kuaishou reportedly keeps ~68%; former Kuaishou SVP Gai Kun/Yu Yue named Kling CEO 2026-09-30). So 'Kuaishou spin-off' is loosely right: Kuaishou still controls and consolidates it. Kling models are closed (API/web) except Kolors 1.0.

records.notes: Unveiled 2024-06-06, invite-only beta in Kuaiying; image-to-video added 2024-06-21; global/public rollout later. Roster date 2024-06-06 is correct for the unveil.

records.categoryBasis: official: text/image-to-video generation model (video output)
records.notes: Official X post 2024-09-19: 1080p in Pro mode, Motion Brush (initially only on 1.0, added to 1.5 on 2024-11-22).

records.categoryBasis: official: text/image-to-video generation model (video output)
records.notes: Standard (720p) and Professional (1080p) modes.

records.categoryBasis: official: text/image-to-video generation model (video output)
records.notes: 2.1 Standard 720p / Pro 1080p (image-to-video first) and 2.1 Master (text- and image-to-video).

records.categoryBasis: official: text/image-to-video generation model (video output)

records.notes: Described as the next version of VIDEO O1 (Omni line), launched with 3.0 on 2026-02-05; upgraded again 2026-06-17.

records.notes: Speed/cost tier of the 3.0 generation, marketed as a separate model; date from secondary coverage of the Kling release note (2026-06-17 18:00 CST). Not a successor to 3.0.

records.notes: Announced/early access 2026-09-28; official blog (dated 09-30) says full model launches in October (not public as of 10-09). Roster date matches the announcement, not general availability.

records.categoryBasis: official: text-to-image / image editing model (image output)

records.notes: Day-2 release of Omni Launch Week (2025-12-02), secondary sources only; text-to-image + instruction editing with up to 10 reference images.

records.notes: IMAGE 3.0 and IMAGE 3.0 Omni launched with VIDEO 3.0 on 2026-02-05; 2K/4K output, series mode. Kept as one record (Omni is a sibling tier).

records.categoryBasis: official: coding LLM (text output) for software engineering / agentic coding
records.notes: Open-weight (Apache-2.0); card says experiments are based on Qwen3-32B. Announced with proprietary KAT-Coder; HF repo created 2025-09-15 (exact day not on official pages).

records.categoryBasis: official: coding LLM (text output) for software engineering / agentic coding
records.notes: Proprietary flagship coder (StreamLake/Wanqing API), 73.4% SWE-Bench Verified; base model not disclosed. Launched with KAT-Dev-32B; blog page carries no date.

records.categoryBasis: official: coding LLM (text output) for software engineering / agentic coding
records.notes: Card: 'the experimental RL version of the KAT-Coder model'; Apache-2.0; HF repo created 2025-10-10 (exact release day not stated). Base checkpoint not named.

records.categoryBasis: official: coding LLM (text output) for software engineering / agentic coding
records.notes: Proprietary; ~March 27 2026 per catalogs (requesty 03-27, zenmux 03-30); exact official day unknown. A KAT-Coder-Pro V1 also existed (novita listing 2026-01). Parent = KAT-Coder line (series).

records.categoryBasis: official: coding LLM (text output) for software engineering / agentic coding
records.notes: HF card: 'Following the release of KAT-Coder-V2.5 in July'; tech report arXiv 2607.05471 (Jul 6). Third-party sites say 2026-07-10 (not verified officially).

records.categoryBasis: official: coding LLM (text output) for software engineering / agentic coding
records.notes: 35B-A3B MoE, Apache-2.0, SFT on 127K examples + RL; open-weight version of KAT-V2.5 recipe ('largely follows'). HF listing 2026-07-23; collection updated Jul 24.

records.categoryBasis: official: vision-language understanding model (text output from image/video input)
records.notes: First Kwai Keye-VL release (README news 2025.06.26; tech report arXiv 2507.01949). Built on Qwen3 + SigLIP codebases.

records.categoryBasis: official: vision-language understanding model (text output from image/video input)
records.notes: README 2025.08.28: slow-fast video encoding, LongCoT cold start, 128K context; arXiv 2509.01563.

records.categoryBasis: official: vision-language understanding model (text output from image/video input)
records.notes: README 2025.11.20: largest Keye-VL to date. Base LLM not stated in README (671B-A37B shape suggests a DeepSeek-V3-class backbone; unverified).

records.categoryBasis: official: vision-language understanding model (text output from image/video input)
records.notes: README 2026.05.25 (Baidu Baike says 05-28); 256K context, DSA attention, built-in search/tool/code agent loops; Apache-2.0; tech report arXiv 2606.10651 (06-10). Parent = 1.5 (reuses its vision encoder).

gaps: Kling 4.0 full model release date: only 'October 2026' announced; as of 2026-10-09 no GA found. kling-4-0 date is the announcement/Flash early-access day.
Kling 3.0 Turbo date comes from secondary coverage of the release note (kling.ai release-notes page returned no content to WebFetch).
Exact official days for KAT-Dev-32B/KAT-Coder (2025-09), KAT-Dev-72B-Exp (2025-10), KAT-Coder-Pro V2 (2026-03) and V2.5 (2026-07) unknown; month only.
Kuaishou IR site returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch; IR press releases were read through search-result excerpts and Nasdaq/GlobeNewswire mirrors.
Keye-VL-671B-A37B base LLM not disclosed on the README.
excluded: Kling feature releases (Motion Control, Motion Brush, lip-sync, effects, Elements 3.0): features not models.
Kling 2.1 Master / 2.0 Master as separate records: merged into 2.x records (same generation/tier names).
KAT-V1-40B, KwaiCoder-23B-A4B, KwaiCoder-AutoThink, SRPO-Qwen-32B, HiPO-*, OASIS-code-*: research artifacts/small releases, not flagship lines.
KwaiYii (2023 LLM), Kolors adapters (ControlNet/IP-Adapter): not notable / derived.
